method: Exactly two ordinary terminal attempts through normal UI at http://127.0.0.1:5173/ using installed Chrome visible driver. Discovery limited to screenshots, visible UI and operator handbook. No source, tests, prior reviews, hidden state or debug URLs inspected.
raw_evidence: Driver actions and screenshots retained without alteration.

attempts.combat: Induction guard killed by rifle optic fire. Patrols mostly avoided; repeated navigation delays under fire.
attempts.boss: Not activated; third memory not recovered.

traversal.result: Crossed low cover after held Space and forward input, progressing archive distance from 17m to 5m. Jump versus vault not independently established. A prior brief Space press did not cross the first obstacle; failure cause unknown.

attempts.combat: Induction guard and a patrol killed by rifle. Breacher fired and shell reload observed; no breacher elimination confirmed. Shift cooldown observed; final summary reports one phase evade, but no interrupt independently confirmed.
attempts.boss: Activated Custodian; three numbered plates, full coil HUD and locking-lanes announcement observed. Approached to 16m and attempted rifle fire, then died. Coil damage, breaks and destruction not established.

traversal.result: Space held at a visible clear-landing vault prompt. Subsequent view remained against architecture; success or failure of that individual vault unknown. Ordinary movement and Shift subsequently reached next areas.

coverage.memory: All three recovery interactions observed across attempt2; post-loss memory reading not opened.
coverage.combat: Rifle critical eliminations, ADS, reload, breacher shots and shell reload, directional threat cues, damage, shield regeneration, Shift cooldown.
coverage.navigation: Facility map opened; held Tab ground trace clearly visible on boss approach. Repeated cover/wall collisions delayed navigation.

strengths: Cohesive rain, cyan/amber lighting and restrained typography establish a strong visual identity.
Readable objective, memory completion cards, receiver floor-ring instruction, distances and mission end summary.
Physical numbered boss plates and explicit coil HUD communicate the target structure.
Rifle critical feedback and distinct weapon silhouettes support combat understanding.
Memory recovery provides tangible supply and health relief.
problems: Cover-heavy archive navigation repeatedly led to walls or obstacles while under fire; straight-line distance alone did not resolve approaches. Map and trace helped, though I did not use them consistently.
Distant patrols are small and visually simple; with multiple directional cues, identifying the immediate damaging source was difficult in these paused synthetic attempts.
Clear-landing vault prompt did not let me confidently infer actual traversal completion from before/after views. This is an uncertainty, not a confirmed traversal defect.
Boss escalation was lethal before I could establish a useful firing angle; this limited review cannot determine its balance for continuous human play.
Weapon/world geometry remains visibly blocky compared with the polished menu and HUD.
rating_scope: Independent provisional judgment of observed slice only. No human enjoyment, audio or hardware certification.
confounds: Browser-timed synthetic DOM inputs and automatic Escape pauses, not continuous human mouse/keyboard play.
Some press steps were effectively extremely brief; held key steps were used later. Unsuccessful brief actions cannot be attributed to game defects.
Long fire batches and approximate screenshot-based aim produced low accuracy and exposed the player.
Software-WebGL fallback enabled; no performance or GPU certification.
Initial deploy remained live while screenshot was inspected, adding mission time before the first action.

cleanup.verification: ps -p 31407,31417 -o pid=,ppid=,comm= returned exit 1 and empty output after driver exit: both exact owned PIDs absent. No unrelated process killed.
